source.name: AEMO NEMWEB dispatch reports
source.attribution: Source: Australian Energy Market Operator, regional reference prices from NEMWEB DISPATCHIS.

notes: AEMO NEMWEB DISPATCH/PRICE RRP, non-intervention market pricing run. UTC timestamps mark interval starts. NEM time is UTC+10.
Prices are dispatch observations. A dispatchStatus field records intervals not marked FIRM at issue. Subsequent AEMO settlement revisions are a separate dataset.
